title: 第三十九章 北方禁地-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一

    玉简里的那句话在脑海中回响，不是大声的，是背景音一样的，持续地、低频地响着。

    苏棠躺在床上，没失眠，但睡得不深。梦里全是旋转的玉简，每一块都在播放同一句话——影子的源头不止一个。

    醒来时，枕边放着一杯温热的茶。三分甜。沈夜白已经下楼了。

    苏棠端起茶杯喝了一口，靠在床头，把胖橘从被子上拎起来放在膝盖上。胖橘被吵醒了，不满地喵了一声，尾巴扫她的手背。

    老板，你昨晚说梦话了。白芷听见了，告诉我的。

    苏棠愣了一下。我说什么了？

    你说'别转，把玉简放下'。胖橘舔了舔爪子，你梦见谁了？

    苏棠没回答，把胖橘放回床上，起身洗漱。

    下楼时，沈夜白已经在柜台后面坐着了。手里拿着一本书，面前一杯茶。白芷在厨房煮粥，小翠擦桌子，大壮搬面粉。

    一切如常。

    但有一个位置空着——靠窗第三张桌子。昨天黑衣人坐过的。

    白芷说那个人什么都没点，只喝了一杯白水。白水不要钱，连灵石都没花。一个不花钱、不点单、只为留一句话的人，在店里坐了一个时辰。这不是闲得慌，是故意的。

    苏棠走到那张桌子旁，弯下腰，用手指摸桌面。

    什么都没有——没有刻字，没有灵力残留，连指纹都没有。干净得像被什么东西擦过。

    苏棠站直身体，在靠窗位置坐下，看着窗外街道。

    白芷，你见过昨天那个黑衣人吗？

    白芷想了想。没有。但我记得他的手——很白，很瘦，手指很长。他喝茶的时候，手腕露出来，上面有一道银色的光，像镯子，又像手链。

    苏棠记住了。银色的光，手指很长。

    二

    上午，苏棠去天机阁找晚棠。

    晚棠正在书房整理碎片——从冰原带回来的十二块，她一块一块记录大小、重量、能量强度。殷无邪在旁边帮忙拓印符文。云隐也在，他最近常来天机阁，说是帮晚棠整理典籍。但苏棠注意到他每次来都带一盒桂花糕，晚棠每次都会吃完。

    晚棠，天机阁的探子有没有见过一个穿黑衣、戴斗笠的男人？手腕上有银色的光，手指很长，像弹琴的。

    晚棠放下手中的碎片，想了想。银色的光？三年前，有一个戴银镯的男人来天机阁，留下这个镯子，说'如果有一天锚点要去北方禁地，就把这个给她'。他没留名字，只说是'北边的人'。

    散修联盟？

    晚棠点头。名义上中立，但和天机阁有合作。天机阁情报网覆盖不到的地方，散修联盟可以。如果那个人真的是'北边的人'，他来甜品店的目的可能不是警告，而是求助。

    苏棠皱眉。求助？求什么？

    晚棠从抽屉里拿出一张旧地图，摊开。地图上标注了修真界各个势力范围，最北边有一片空白，空白处写着两个字——禁地。

    散修联盟总部在北方，靠近冰原。他们一直负责监控碎片坠落区域。最近的报告说，禁地深处出现了异常能量波动。和碎片波动不同，但更古老、更强大。

    晚棠看着苏棠。

    他们可能发现了另一个影子的源头。但他们没有锚点，进不去。所以他们来找你。

    苏棠的手指在地图上划过，停在禁地两个字上。

    禁地。听名字就不是好地方。

    晚棠，散修联盟的人，可靠吗？

    晚棠沉默了片刻。散修联盟的人不站任何宗门，只站自己。但'北边的人'不一样。他立过誓——不参与势力争斗，只守护北方边境。冰原上的碎片坠落区，一直都是他在巡视。

    苏棠把地图上的路线记在心里。北方，禁地，另一个影子源头。

    三

    回到甜品店时，发现沈夜白不在柜台后面。

    白芷说他上楼了，有事。苏棠上楼，推开沈夜白房间的门。他坐在床边，手里拿着一封信，脸色比平时严肃。

    怎么了？

    沈夜白把信递给她。剑宗传来的。北方边境出现异常天象，天空中有暗红色光在闪烁，和碎片颜色一样，但范围更大。探子说，那片区域方圆百里寸草不生，所有生灵都逃离了。

    苏棠接过信，读完。

    暗红色的光，范围更大，寸草不生——这不是碎片，是另一个影子源头在苏醒。

    她想起小棠说的话——其他方向有类似的能量波动。北方，就是其中之一。

    银镯来了，影子源头就出现了。不是巧合。苏棠把信还给沈夜白，他知道那里会出事，所以来找我。

    沈夜白站起来，把剑挂在腰间。什么时候出发？

    明天一早。今天我要准备一些东西——白芷的干粮、胖橘的鱼干、小青龙的灵蜜糕，还有生命灵泉。苏棠掰着手指数，对了，还要带一件厚斗篷。北方冷。

    沈夜白看着苏棠，眉心舒展了一些——他很少笑，但眉心舒展就是笑。

    你以前出门从不带这么多东西。

    以前是一个人。现在不是。

    苏棠转身走出房间，脚步轻快。

    四

    出发那天，天没亮苏棠就醒了。

    她躺在床上，听着窗外风声。云梦泽的清晨很安静，只有远处坊市偶尔传来几声犬吠。胖橘蜷在她膝盖上，睡得正香；小青龙盘在她脖子上，鳞片温温热热；沈夜白在隔壁房间——她能听见他翻身的声音。

    她起来，洗漱，换衣服。

    今天穿的是白芷新做的那套——厚棉外袍，里面是皮袄，腰间系银色腰带。白芷说师姐你去北方，穿厚一点。苏棠看着镜子里的人，觉得自己像一头熊。

    她摇了摇头，把匕首别在腰间，把沈夜白送的听雪剑挂在背上。包袱里塞满了东西——干粮、丹药、灵泉、地图，还有一本白芷塞进去的《修真界美食指南》，说路上万一饿了可以找好吃的。

    下楼时，所有人都已经在店里了。

    白芷在厨房煮粥，胖橘蹲在柜台上当招财猫，小青龙盘在柱子上，小雪飘在空中。云隐和云逸坐在靠窗桌子旁，面前摆着两杯茶。晚棠也在，深红色长发披散着，怀里抱着一个大包袱。

    给你准备的。晚棠把包袱递过来，北方禁地很冷，天机阁有弟子去过，带了军用的保暖斗篷和帐篷。还有足够的符箓和丹药。不够用随时传讯。

    苏棠接过包袱，沉甸甸的。够用了。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

1

The sentence in the jade slip echoed in my mind, not loudly, but like background sound, ringing continuously and at a low frequency.

Su Tang was lying on the bed, not having insomnia, but not sleeping deeply.The dream was full of spinning jade slips, each piece playing the same sentence - there is more than one source of shadow.

When I woke up, there was a cup of warm tea by my pillow.Three points sweet.Shen Yebai has already gone downstairs.

Su Tang picked up the teacup and took a sip, then leaned against the bedside, lifted Fat Orange up from the quilt and put it on his knees.Fat Orange was woken up, meowing dissatisfiedly, and brushed the back of her hand with her tail.

Boss, you were talking in your sleep last night.Bai Zhi heard it and told me.

Su Tang was stunned for a moment.What did I say?

You said, 'Don't turn around, put the jade slip down'.Fat Orange licked his paw, who are you dreaming about?

Su Tang didn’t answer. He put Fat Orange back on the bed and got up to wash up.

When he went downstairs, Shen Yebai was already sitting behind the counter.A book in hand and a cup of tea in front of her.Bai Zhi is cooking porridge in the kitchen, Xiao Cui is cleaning the table, and Da Zhuang is carrying flour.

Everything is business as usual.

But there is one seat vacant - the third table by the window.The man in black sat there yesterday.

Bai Zhi said that the man didn’t order anything and only drank a glass of water.Baishui didn't need any money, not even spiritual stones.A person who didn't spend money or order, just to leave a message, sat in the store for an hour.This is not because of idleness, but on purpose.

Su Tang walked to the table, bent down, and touched the tabletop with his fingers.

There is nothing - no engravings, no spiritual power residue, not even fingerprints.It was as clean as if something had wiped it.

Su Tang stood up straight, sat down by the window, and looked out the window at the street.

Bai Zhi, have you seen the man in black yesterday?

Bai Zhi thought for a while.No.But I remember his hands—very white, thin, with long fingers.When he was drinking tea, his wrist was exposed, and there was a silver light on it, like a bracelet or bracelet.

Su Tang remembered it.Silver light, long fingers.

2

In the morning, Su Tang went to Tianji Pavilion to find Wan Tang.

Wan Tang is sorting out the fragments in the study - twelve pieces brought back from the ice field. She records the size, weight, and energy intensity one by one.Yin Wuxie was at the side helping to rub the runes.Yun Yin is also there. He often comes to Tianji Pavilion recently, saying that he is helping Wan Tang organize the classics.But Su Tang noticed that he brought a box of osmanthus cake every time he came, and Wan Tang would finish it every time.

Wan Tang, have the spies from Tianji Pavilion seen a man wearing black clothes and a bamboo hat?There is a silver light on the wrist, and the fingers are very long, like a piano player.

Wan Tang put down the fragments in his hands and thought about it.Silver light?Three years ago, a man wearing a silver bracelet came to Tianji Pavilion, left this bracelet, and said, 'If Anchor goes to the northern forbidden land one day, give this to her.'He didn't leave a name, just said he was 'from the north'.

​​ Alliance of Loose Cultivators?

Wan Tang nodded.Neutral in name, but cooperating with Tianji Pavilion.Where the Tianji Pavilion Intelligence Network cannot cover, the Rogue Cultivator Alliance can.If that person is really a 'Northern Man', his purpose in coming to the dessert shop may not be to warn, but to ask for help.

Su Tang frowned.Help?What do you want?

Wan Tang took out an old map from the drawer and spread it out.The various spheres of influence in the cultivation world are marked on the map. There is a blank space in the far north, and two words are written in the blank space - forbidden land.

The headquarters of the Loose Cultivator Alliance is in the north, close to the ice field.They have been monitoring the area where debris fell.Recent reports say that there are abnormal energy fluctuations deep in the forbidden area.Different from Shard Wave, but older and more powerful.

Wan Tang looked at Su Tang.

They may have discovered the source of another shadow.But they have no anchor and can't get in.So they come to you.

Su Tang’s finger crossed the map and stopped at the word forbidden area.

Forbidden land.The name just doesn't sound like a good place.

Wan Tang, are the people from the Loose Cultivators Alliance reliable?

Wan Tang was silent for a moment.People in the Loose Cultivator Alliance do not support any sect, only themselves.But 'Northside Man' is different.He made an oath not to participate in power struggles and only to protect the northern border.He has been patrolling the debris fall area on the ice sheet.

Su Tang kept the route on the map in mind.The north, the forbidden land, another source of shadow.

Three

When I returned to the dessert shop, I found that Shen Yebai was not behind the counter.

Bai Zhi said he went upstairs and had something to do.Su Tang went upstairs and opened the door of Shen Yebai's room.He was sitting on the edge of the bed, holding a letter in his hand, his face serious than usual.

What's wrong?

Shen Yebai handed the letter to her.It came from Jian Zong.An unusual celestial phenomenon occurred on the northern border. There was a dark red light flashing in the sky, which was the same color as the debris, but with a larger range.The spies said that there was no grass growing in that area for hundreds of miles, and all living creatures had fled.

Su Tang took the letter and read it.

The dark red light has a wider range and is barren of grass - this is not a fragment, it is another shadow source awakening.

She remembered what Xiaotang said - there were similar energy fluctuations in other directions.North is one of them.

When the silver bracelet comes, the source of the shadow appears.Not a coincidence.Su Tang returned the letter to Shen Yebai. He knew something would happen there, so he came to see me.

Shen Yebai stood up and hung his sword on his waist.When to leave?

Tomorrow morning.Today I need to prepare some things - dry food from Angelica dahurica, dried fish from Fat Orange, Lingmi cake from Xiao Qinglong, and the Spring of Life.Su Tang counted the numbers on his hands. By the way, he also needed to wear a thick cloak.It's cold in the north.

Shen Yebai looked at Su Tang, his eyebrows stretched a little - he rarely smiled, but when he stretched his eyebrows, he smiled.

You have never brought so many things with you before going out.

I used to be alone.Not now.

Su Tang turned around and walked out of the room, his steps brisk.

Four

On the day of departure, Su Tang woke up before dawn.

She was lying on the bed, listening to the wind outside the window.The morning in Yunmengze was very quiet, with only a few barking dogs occasionally coming from the distant city.Fat Orange was curled up on her knees, sleeping soundly; Little Green Dragon was coiled around her neck, its scales warm; Shen Yebai was in the next room - she could hear the sound of him turning over.

She got up, washed and changed clothes.

Today I’m wearing Bai Zhi’s new outfit—a thick cotton outer robe with a leather jacket underneath and a silver belt around my waist.Bai Zhi said, senior sister, if you go to the north, wear thicker clothes.Su Tang looked at the person in the mirror and felt like a bear.

She shook her head, put the dagger on her waist, and hung the Tingxue Sword given by Shen Ye in vain on her back.The baggage was stuffed with things - dry food, elixirs, spiritual springs, maps, and a "Cultivation World Food Guide" stuffed by Angelica dahurica, saying that if you get hungry on the way, you can find delicious food.

When we went downstairs, everyone was already in the store.

Bai Zhi is cooking porridge in the kitchen, Fat Orange is squatting on the counter as a lucky cat, the little green dragon is coiled on the pillar, and light snow is floating in the air.Yun Yin and Yun Yi were sitting at the table by the window, with two cups of tea in front of them.Wan Tang was also there, with long dark red hair hanging loose, holding a big bundle in her arms.

Prepared for you.Wan Tang handed over the baggage. It was very cold in the northern forbidden area. Some disciples from Tianji Pavilion had been there and brought military-style warm cloaks and tents.There are also enough talismans and elixirs.Not enough for summons at any time.

Su Tang took the burden, which was heavy.That's enough.
